entities.summary: West Bank, a political institution in Jordan during Emirate and Kingdom of Jordan (1948–1951). Grew from Jordan's Arab Legion captures the West Bank and East Jerusalem and King Abdullah I assassinated at Al-Aqsa Mosque. Led to the emergence of Jordan loses the West Bank and East Jerusalem to Israel in the Six-Day War and Hussein.
